result.topic_en: The page defines a surface integral and a line integral of a vector field (X, Y, Z), possibly in an electrical context, and computes the circulation around an infinitesimal rectangle to obtain the curl components ι1, ι2, ι3.
result.transcription:
$[?] = \int\left(X\frac{\partial x}{\partial p} + Y\frac{\partial y}{\partial p} + Z\frac{\partial z}{\partial p}\right)ds$ p Normale nach innen[?] positiv
$F = \int(X\,dx + Y\,dy + Z\,dz)$ F die von [-oben-] nach unten hindurchgehende Electricitätsmenge[?]
{+Integral[?]+} Integral von links nach rechts[?]

[Figur: Axen z, y, x mit kleinem Rechteck]

Die positive Z Axe nach oben; positive Y Axe, zur Linken von der positiven X Axe.
$-\iota_3\,\delta x\,\delta y = \int_0^{\delta y} Y\,dy + \int_0^{\delta x} X\,dx_{y+dy} + \int_{\delta y}^0 Y\,dy_{x+dx} + \int_{\delta x}^0 X\,dx$
$= \int_0^{\delta y}\left(\frac{\partial Y}{\partial x}\right)\delta x\,dy - \int_0^{\delta x}\frac{\partial X}{\partial y}\delta y\,dx$
$\iota_3 = \frac{\partial X}{\partial y} - \frac{\partial Y}{\partial x}$
$\iota_1 = \frac{\partial Y}{\partial z} - \frac{\partial Z}{\partial y}$
$\iota_2 = \frac{\partial Z}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial X}{\partial z}$
